Qualified experimental RetainedAffineOpaque candidate is preserved as a six-path patch against recovery commit 066be6c11960de26a8825811f12241af6e5120a1. Exact patch: /Users/bbuchsbaum/code/scala/plsneuro/output/brain-display/updates-27/retained-layout.patch, SHA256 64f28a9c65abe83c99f270b883f91cff6a7c5a3217b7abe8e3b5d7dd094f11b1. It applies cleanly in isolated patch-check; all 16 complete affine candidate files match the tested source. No source files were restored into the shared main checkout. Original 14 pre-switch hashes all match the recovery commit. Native ownership remains ScalaFIM; consumer provider contract remains ed388817ffdcf54bf8a9561eb2d8c34d44f039d82b323b1949b49f269988d73c / AdaptiveAffineOpaque.

Implementation: prefer a feasible cyclic corner nearest componentwise RGB median, retain it while valid, promote invalid faces to four midpoint children and retain those refinements through compatible updates; never upload UVs on stable updates. Retained counts consume the configured face budget, and over-budget changes preserve the old scene/pick plan. Original geometry/face/barycentric identity and midpoint morphs retained. No scientific scalar/threshold changes. The existing no-mipmap + centroid runtime component remains required.

43 JavaFX tests, 128 view JVM + 128 JS tests pass with recorded dependency overrides. Native 6000 picks and atomic refusal pass. All 576 fresh/pre-refined native analytic color cases pass unchanged two-level footprint/AA-off-center and permutation gates: max footprint excess 1.2223, max no-AA center error 1.4514, max permutation difference 1. Cortex default-lighting inversion promotes 3 of 549018 faces -> 549027. Warm median completed backend-update+snapshot 21.13 ms versus 211.69 ms earlier adaptive, zero UV bytes. First refinement remains 687.38 ms. Soft and unlit promote zero faces with warm medians 21.91/18.76 ms. All 15 final cortex comparisons differ by at most one channel level. Earlier first-feasible-anchor results and failures are retained separately.

Evidence and exact source/runtime/data: /Users/bbuchsbaum/code/scala/plsneuro/output/brain-display/updates-27/evidence.json; complete native protocol in candidate/docs/visual-qa/javafx-adaptive-updates.md. Color inputs/images and frozen runtimes archived. Tests use original RGB inversion, not ordinary UI events. First native build failure due to Alder relative sibling refs remains separate (bd-01M24KM6PN5JX95MEWW8WXEVXR); Intaglio override also explicit. No whole-build or provider-main adoption claim.

Ticket remains open: eliminate first-refinement full-scene stall (affected-chunk replacement is the next bounded hypothesis), measure ordinary palette/threshold/opacity/FIR input-to-paint including plan work, resident memory and long-session growth, then integrate/requalify the provider candidate and consumer. No runtime default, app source, pin, commit or publication changed. All owned native runs have exited without showing Stages. Releasing original-checkout leases so provider integration can proceed; do not adopt the new policy by copying whole current native modules into the older app contract.
